verdict.rationale: Render documents a REST API and publishes an OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, and it also offers a CLI and an MCP server for managing services and datastores programmatically. Nothing in the evidence shows that the API covers everything the dashboard can do, so parity is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or coverage map, evidence that settings like custom domains, environment variables, rollbacks and scaling are API-exposed, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use the Render CLI to manage your Render services and datastores directly from your terminal
Render's Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables you to manage your Render infrastructure directly from compatible AI apps
